2026_03_BAL_DAL.headline: Jackson and Prescott bring contrasting pressure points into Rio
2026_03_BAL_DAL.paragraph1: Lamar Jackson gives Baltimore the ability to punish Dallas when its rush loses contain, while Dak Prescott arrives in Rio after a sharp Week 2 response from the Cowboys offense. Baltimore is also monitoring Zay Flowers, which could change how aggressively the Ravens attack outside. Dallas has defensive injury concerns of its own, so Brian Schottenheimer may need Prescott to sustain drives and keep Jackson from controlling possession with Baltimore’s run game.
2026_03_BAL_DAL.model_rationale: Baltimore can stress Dallas horizontally and vertically through Jackson, while the Cowboys need Prescott to sustain efficient possessions and keep a depleted defense from carrying the matchup.
